intervals.label: proposed
intervals.quote: The Jinping Neutrino Experiment (hereafter referred to as the Jinping experiment) was proposed in 2015

placements.note: The existing CJPL-II site record is a campus-grade point for the laboratory; the proposed experimental hall inside it has no published coordinate.
placements.quote: We propose to use one of the new tunnels to build a neutrino experiment with a fiducial target mass of two kilo-ton for solar neutrino physics

fiducial_mass.quote: with a fiducial mass of 2 kilotons for neutrino-electron scattering events

target_mass.quote: The proposed experiment will have target mass of 4 kilotons of liquid scintillator or water-based liquid scintillator

summary.plain: A planned tank holding several thousand tonnes of liquid scintillator, to be built in a new tunnel of the Jinping underground laboratory, so deep that almost no cosmic rays reach it.
summary.technical: Proposed detector in a CJPL-II tunnel with 4 kt of liquid scintillator or water-based (slow) liquid scintillator; the 2017 design paper discusses cylindrical and spherical vessels and plans two detectors in the CJPL experimental hall.

technology.quote: The proposed experiment will have target mass of 4 kilotons of liquid scintillator or water-based liquid scintillator
technology.value: Liquid scintillator or water-based slow liquid scintillator target viewed by photomultipliers, in a cylindrical or spherical vessel
